

{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating Markdown-to-HTML converter with tokenizer, renderer, and tests."}],"files":[{"path":"src/tokenizer.mjs","content":"export function tokenize(markdown) {\n  const tokens = [];\n  const lines = markdown.split('\\n');\n  let i = 0;\n\n  while (i < lines.length) {\n    const line = lines[i];\n\n    // Fenced code block\n    if (line.startsWith('```')) {\n      const codeLines = [];\n      i++;\n      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].startsWith('```')) {\n        codeLines.push(lines[i]);\n        i++;\n      }\n      tokens.push({ type: 'code_block', content: codeLines.join('\\n') });\n      i++; // skip closing ```\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    // Horizontal rule: --- or ***\n    if (/^(-{3,}|\\*{3,})$/.test(line.trim())) {\n      tokens.push({ type: 'hr' });\n      i++;\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    // Headings (level 1-3)\n    const headingMatch = line.match(/^(#{1,3})\\s+(.*)/);\n    if (headingMatch) {\n      tokens.push({\n        type: 'heading',\n        level: headingMatch[1].length,\n        content: headingMatch[2],\n      });\n      i++;\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    // List items\n    const listMatch = line.match(/^[-*]\\s+(.*)/);\n    if (listMatch) {\n      const listLines = [listMatch[1]];\n      i++;\n      while (\n        i < lines.length &&\n        /^[-*]\\s+(.*)/.test(lines[i])\n      ) {\n        listLines.push(lines[i].replace(/^[-*]\\s+/, ''));\n        i++;\n      }\n      tokens.push({ type: 'list_item', content: listLines.join('\\n') });\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    // Paragraph: collect consecutive non-empty lines\n    const paraLines = [];\n    while (\n      i < lines.length &&\n      lines[i].trim() !== '' &&\n      !lines[i].startsWith('```') &&\n      !/^(-{3,}|\\*{3,})$/.test(lines[i].trim()) &&\n      !/^(#{1,3})\\s+/.test(lines[i]) &&\n      !/^[-*]\\s+/.test(lines[i])\n    ) {\n      paraLines.push(lines[i]);\n      i++;\n    }\n    if (paraLines.length > 0) {\n      tokens.push({ type: 'paragraph', content: paraLines.join('\\n') });\n    }\n  }\n\n  return tokens;\n}\n","path":"src/renderer.mjs","content":"function escapeHtml(str) {\n  return str\n    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')\n    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')\n    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');\n}\n\nexport function render(tokens) {\n  const parts = [];\n  let inList = false;\n\n  for (const token of tokens) {\n    switch (token.type) {\n      case 'heading': {\n        if (inList) {\n          parts.push('</ul>');\n          inList = false;\n        }\n        const tag = `h${token.level}`;\n        parts.push(`<${tag}>${escapeHtml(token.content)}</${tag}>`);\n        break;\n      }\n      case 'paragraph': {\n        if (inList) {\n          parts.push('</ul>');\n          inList = false;\n        }\n        parts.push(`<p>${escapeHtml(token.content)}</p>`);\n        break;\n      }\n      case 'code_block': {\n        if (inList) {\n          parts.push('</ul>');\n          inList = false;\n        }\n        parts.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHtml(token.content)}</code></pre>`);\n        break;\n      }\n      case 'list_item': {\n        if (!inList) {\n          parts.push('<ul>');\n          inList = true;\n        }\n        const items = token.content.split('\\n');\n        for (const item of items) {\n          parts.push(`<li>${escapeHtml(item)}</li>`);\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      case 'hr': {\n        if (inList) {\n          parts.push('</ul>');\n          inList = false;\n        }\n        parts.push('<hr>');\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (inList) {\n    parts.push('</ul>');\n  }\n\n  return parts.join('\\n');\n}\n","path":"test/tokenizer.test.mjs","content":"import { test } from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert';\nimport { tokenize } from '../src/tokenizer.mjs';\n\ntest('heading levels 1-3', () => {\n  const tokens = tokenize('# H1\\n## H2\\n### H3');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens.length, 3);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].type, 'heading');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].level, 1);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].content, 'H1');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[1].type, 'heading');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[1].level, 2);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[1].content, 'H2');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[2].type, 'heading');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[2].level, 3);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[2].content, 'H3');\n});\n\ntest('fenced code block', () => {\n  const md = '```\\nconst x = 1;\\n```';\n  const tokens = tokenize(md);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens.length, 1);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].type, 'code_block');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].content, 'const x = 1;');\n});\n\ntest('paragraph', () => {\n  const tokens = tokenize('Hello world');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens.length, 1);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].type, 'paragraph');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].content, 'Hello world');\n});\n\ntest('mixed content', () => {\n  const md = '# Title\\n\\nA paragraph.\\n\\n- item 1\\n- item 2\\n\\n---\\n\\n```\\ncode\\n```';\n  const tokens = tokenize(md);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens.length, 5);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].type, 'heading');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[0].level, 1);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[1].type, 'paragraph');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[2].type, 'list_item');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[3].type, 'hr');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens[4].type, 'code_block');\n});\n\ntest('horizontal rule', () => {\n  const tokens1 = tokenize('---');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens1.length, 1);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens1[0].type, 'hr');\n\n  const tokens2 = tokenize('***');\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens2.length, 1);\n  assert.strictEqual(tokens2[0].type, 'hr');\n});\n","path":"test/renderer.test.mjs","content":"import { test } from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert';\nimport { render } from '../src/renderer.mjs';\n\ntest('heading renders to correct tag', () => {\n  const tokens = [\n    { type: 'heading', level: 1, content: 'Hello' },\n    { type: 'heading', level: 2, content: 'World' },\n    { type: 'heading', level: 3, content: 'Test' },\n  ];\n  const html = render(tokens);\n  assert.ok(html.includes('<h1>Hello</h1>'));\n  assert.ok(html.includes('<h2>World</h2>'));\n  assert.ok(html.includes('<h3>Test</h3>'));\n});\n\ntest('code block gets pre+code', () => {\n  const tokens = [{ type: 'code_block', content: 'const x = 1;' }];\n  const html = render(tokens);\n  assert.ok(html.includes('<pre><code>const x = 1;</code></pre>'));\n});\n\ntest('special chars are escaped in paragraphs', () => {\n  const tokens = [{ type: 'paragraph', content: '<div>&amp;</div>' }];\n  const html = render(tokens);\n  assert.ok(html.includes('&lt;div&gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/div&gt;'));\n  assert.ok(!html.includes('<div>'));\n});\n"}
